BERT4Rec explicitly acknowledges the mismatch between interior masked-item reconstruction and future-item prediction; it appends a reserved MASK at inference and also trains on last-item masking. This motivates terminal supervision but does not establish whether reconstruction gradients help it. [BERT4Rec](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.06690). Gradient direction and magnitude should be measured separately: PCGrad examines conflicting directions, GradNorm addresses magnitude imbalance, and a 2024 study investigates weighting during gradient conflicts. None establishes the outcome for this Amazon benchmark. [PCGrad](https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.06782), [GradNorm](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.02257), [2024 task weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.01793).

Suggested diagnostic: on a few cached training batches, compute g_terminal=∇(λ_terminal·L_terminal) and g_reconstruction=∇(λ_reconstruction·L_reconstruction), preserving actual reduction denominators. Report norms, dot products, cosine similarity and terminal alignment with their summed gradient, globally and separately for item embeddings, positional embeddings and each encoder block. Negative cosine indicates local opposition; near-zero norms make cosine unreliable. These are local loss diagnostics, not evidence of improved HR@10. Use torch.autograd.grad without optimizer steps; preserve model mode, buffers and Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG states, with cached corruption or isolated generators. PyTorch provides RNG forking/restoration. [PyTorch RNG documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/random.html).

Persist checkpoint/category identifiers, batch hashes, masked inputs, target positions, terminal/reconstruction membership and overlap, coefficients, loss numerators/denominators, dropout mode and component metrics. This proposed provenance makes measurements auditable without fitting another model. For left padding, terminal probes must read the final nonpadding MASK position; never expose the terminal target elsewhere in its bidirectional input. Actual allocation and conflict measurements remain unavailable until these probes run.
